### MongoDB query shapes, $queryStats, profiler and index usage

- **MongoDB query shapes, $queryStats, profiler and index usage** · self

### query shape

- **query shape** · part — - Query Shape Reports are not available through the Atlas Administration API. · aka: query shapes, queryShape, query hash, queryHash, queryShapeHash, $queryStats, queryStats, query stats, query statistics, queryStatsRateLimit, planSummary — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/query-shape-insights.md#limitations

### $indexStats

- **$indexStats** · part — $indexStats is not allowed in transactions. · aka: indexStats, index stats, index usage, index usage statistics, unused index, unused indexes, accesses.ops, dropIndex, drop unused index — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/indexStats/

### database profiler

- **database profiler** · part — Database profiler output, in the command.comment field. · aka: profiler, db.setProfilingLevel, setProfilingLevel, profiling level, system.profile, slowms, slowOpThresholdMs, slow query log, slowOpSampleRate, log slow operations, COLLSCAN, collection scan, COLLSCAN stage, slow query log, Slow query entries, slow query entries — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/setindexcommitquorum/

### index effectiveness

- **index effectiveness** · measure · aka: measure index use, index selectivity, selectivity, keys examined ratio, docs examined ratio, examined to returned, totalKeysExamined / nReturned, index hit ratio

### $currentOp

- **$currentOp** · related · aka: currentOp, db.currentOp, killOp, long-running operations, maxTimeMS

### query optimization

- **query optimization** · hypernym · aka: query performance, optimize queries, query optimizer, analyze query performance

### index

- **index** · hypernym — Index errors found during the collection scan phase, except duplicate key errors, are returned immediately and then the index build stops. Earlier MongoDB versions return errors in the commit phase, which occurs near the end of the index build. MongoDB 7.1 helps you to rapidly diagnose index errors. · aka: indexes, indices, indexing — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-creation/
